$comment: AUTHORED half of the room registry — the part no derivation can produce. expected-set.json is frozen and says WHAT each room holds; this says what each room SAYS and HOW it renders. face-sections.mjs merges the two into rooms.generated.json. Every room in the contract must appear here or generation fails: a room with no sentence is a room nobody designed.
$sentence: Each room opens with a declarative sentence, not a title — the pattern taken from the owner's reference design, where 'If it isn't an event, it didn't happen.' does more work than a heading ever could. A sentence states the room's LAW; a title states its filing category. Four are the reference's own words, kept verbatim and marked.
$render: bespoke = a hand-built panel set, because the template cannot express this room's job. generic = the 6-zone lane template (ADR-1306) fed by the derived inventory. index = renders a WHOLE inventory rather than a slice of it, because nothing in the contract maps TO this room — see org and concepts, which would otherwise render as convincing empty rooms, the exact failure D7 names.

today.sentence: The company ran all night. Here is what it did.
today.lede: the brief, the numbers that moved, and what is waiting on you — one screen, forty lines, no route change

inbox.sentence: A machine may raise it. Only you may decide it.
inbox.lede: the one write path in this product — a typed reason, no bulk action, no default, no undo

map.sentence: If it is not on this map, it is not in the company.
map.lede: every room a station, every lane a line — unexercised drawn dashed, planned drawn dotted, in-flight dots moving on receipt

spine.sentence: If it isn't an event, it didn't happen.
spine.lede: append-only, canonical JSONL, a closed vocabulary of 46 kinds — corrections supersede, nothing is edited

board.sentence: Every lane, its phase, and what it is burning.
board.lede: the portfolio view — appetite spent against appetite bought, and how far each lane is from its own kill line

ask-arc.sentence: Ask in words. Every answer carries its receipt.
ask-arc.lede: a brain with no hands — it reads the live state, cites the ULID, and cannot stamp anything

engine-room.sentence: The model is a swappable part. The process is not.
engine-room.lede: drivers, routers and budgets — the identity is the process file, the receipts and the constitution

model-policy.lede: which tier each process runs at, and why a change is a reviewed diff rather than a quiet edit (ADR-0069)

policy.sentence: Deny by default. Every capability earns its level.
policy.lede: the subject table — what each process may touch, and the two keys that must turn for it to change

scheduler.lede: jobs, their next fire, their last outcome, and the heartbeat that proves the clock is alive

memory.sentence: A correction made twice becomes a rule.
memory.lede: the playbook — what recall costs today, and which lessons were promoted out of the retro log

evolve.sentence: Measured, or it did not improve.
evolve.lede: champion against challenger, with a sample floor and a holdout — the winner lands as a reviewed diff, never self-merged

bench.lede: scored runs per driver per process, and what a disagreement between two of them costs to settle

absorb.sentence: What arrives from outside is quarantined before it is believed.
absorb.lede: intake — a candidate tool, skill or dependency is reported and vetted, and nothing installs itself

council-chamber.lede: blind parallel debate, a verifier grading every point, one bounded rebuttal, then a verdict that commits with its dissent

develop.sentence: A phase closes on evidence, or it does not close.
develop.lede: the execution harness — slices, their proofs, and the Definition of Done each one is measured against

review-ship.lede: seven gates, commit-keyed — a new commit is a new review, and a profile switches the whole set as one. The workflows below are what RUNS them; whether the last run was green is not instrumented here, and this room will not imply it from a list of names

design-studio.sentence: A rule unbroken is not the same as work worth shipping.
design-studio.lede: briefs, explores, critiques and renders — and the BELOW-BAR class that exists because zero violations once meant a passing grade

toolbelt.sentence: Every command, every agent, every rule — one place to look.
toolbelt.lede: 26 commands, 30 agents, 7 hooks, 7 rules, and the lints that hold them; click one and the face explains it

money.sentence: Real and simulated are different substances.
money.lede: revenue.received is real-only and has never fired; everything else on this screen says so in its own colour

growth.sentence: Reach is capped before it is measured.
growth.lede: channels, what each published, and the caps that hold at every autonomy level

leads.lede: who was researched, who was contacted inside the daily cap, who replied, and what was actually offered

legal.sentence: Nothing ships under his name without a human hand.
legal.lede: the content gates, the claims that need a source, and the pieces held at the publish gate right now

ops.lede: planned, drawn dotted — this room opens when a second venture is running and support stops being one person

trader.sentence: Paper only, until a written rule change unlocks it.
trader.lede: planned, drawn dotted — real-money trading sits at L0 behind a 72-hour cooldown and an amendment, not a toggle

discover.sentence: The next venture is chosen, not stumbled into.
discover.lede: planned, drawn dotted — opens when the venture #2 slot needs filling from a scored field, not a hunch

ventures.sentence: The factory is not the product.
ventures.lede: each venture in its own repo with its own money and its own kill criteria — the venture track wins every tie

law.sentence: It outranks every roadmap, plan, and line of code.
law.lede: three eternal articles, ten working ones, and the friction any amendment has to survive

learn.sentence: Correct it twice, it becomes impossible.
learn.lede: the retro loop — repeated corrections become permanent setup upgrades, and the ones still sleeping say what would wake them

strategy.sentence: One plan is live per lane. The rest are history.
strategy.lede: the plans, the ADRs behind them, and the decisions that are now too expensive to revisit

org.sentence: Sixteen lanes. Who is awake, who is idle, who is blocked.
org.lede: the company as a roster rather than a board — every lane, its status, and the one thing it is waiting on

concepts.sentence: Every word arc uses, and the room it lives in.
concepts.lede: 107 terms, each anchored to a room and a station — this is what the command palette searches

lane.sentence: One lane, six zones, the same shape every time.
lane.lede: the template every born lane instantiates — plan, phase, burn, gates, evidence, and what it owes right now

chat-mcp.sentence: arc answers from anywhere you already are.
chat-mcp.lede: planned, drawn dotted -- the door already speaks HTTP, so this is a surface question and not an engine one
